import c = collections
import text

class Tree()
    nodes := c.BinaryNodes<int>()
    c.NodeId | none root := none

    private c.NodeId .insert(c.NodeId | none id, int key)
        match id
            none
                return .nodes.add(key)
            c.NodeId
                node := nodes.get(id)
                if key < node.value
                    node.left = .insert(node.left, key)
                else
                    node.right = .insert(node.right, key)
                .nodes.set(id, node)
                return id

    void .add(int key)
        root = .insert(root, key)

    private c.NodeId | none .erase(c.NodeId | none id, int key)
        match id
            none
                return none
            c.NodeId
                node := nodes.get(id)
                if key < node.value
                    node.left = .erase(node.left, key)
                elif key > node.value
                    node.right = .erase(node.right, key)
                else
                    match node.right
                        none
                            return node.left
                        c.NodeId right
                            if not nodes.present(node.left)
                                return right
                            successor, remaining := .nodes.detach_leftmost(right)
                            node.value = successor
                            node.right = remaining
                .nodes.set(id, node)
                return id

    void .remove(int key)
        root = .erase(root, key)

void show(string label, int[] order)
    println("{label}: {text.join(order, " ")}")

tree := Tree()
keys := [50, 27, 74, 13, 39, 62, 88, 6, 31, 45, 70, 34]
for key := keys[]
    .tree.add(key)
for order := ["inorder", "preorder", "postorder"][]
    show(order, tree.nodes.traverse(tree.root, order))
show("levelorder", tree.nodes.levelorder(tree.root))
println("height: {tree.nodes.height(tree.root)}")
.tree.remove(6)
.tree.remove(27)
show("preorder after deletions", tree.nodes.traverse(tree.root, "preorder"))
println("height after deletions: {tree.nodes.height(tree.root)}")
